electrical.specific_condition: Clarification needed on which door numbers require line voltage power supplied above the door header for specified hardware.

electrical.specific_condition: Electrical Contract drawings do not indicate which interior metal ducts require bonding and lack details for bonding requirements.

electrical.specific_condition: The door and entry location for Mechanical Room 0246 was shifted, requiring a relocation of the lighting layout.

electrical.specific_condition: Mechanical Room 0244B was added as shown in City Comments #3 on Architectural drawing P3-A02-01B

electrical.specific_condition: Lighting control MSTP and CAT6 cabling installation required to be in conduit instead of free air in areas with drop ceilings.
electrical.impact: Increased costs and additional work required to install cabling in conduit instead of free air.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Change in installation method for cabling due to design team direction.
electrical.prevention_action: Ensure clear communication and agreement on installation methods during design phase to avoid conflicts in execution.

electrical.specific_condition: F05 fixture elevations specified at 10'-0" AFF cannot be achieved due to Phase 3 ESS duct obstructions in Corridor #262.

electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Duct obstructions preventing specified fixture elevation installation

electrical.specific_condition: Discrepancy between grounding details for the Raised Access Floor system, specifically bonding intervals shown on drawings P3-E03-20 and P3-E03-21.
electrical.impact: Potential confusion and additional work required to align grounding practices with the correct bonding intervals, affecting the installation process.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Inconsistent grounding detail specifications between drawings.
electrical.prevention_action: Ensure consistent grounding detail specifications across all relevant drawings during the design phase.

electrical.specific_condition: Spec section 26 05 20 states that MC cable is only permitted for light fixture connections, but it references a delegated design submittal requirement for MC cable support, implying broader use may be acceptable.
electrical.impact: Uncertainty regarding the use of MC cable for feeder installations led to the need for clarification and potential changes in installation methods, resulting in additional work and costs.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Ambiguity in specification regarding permitted use of MC cable
electrical.prevention_action: Clarify specifications regarding cable types and their permitted applications during the design phase.

electrical.specific_condition: DPR requested a minimum conduit size of 1" for phase 3 BIM coordination instead of the previously suggested 1/2".
electrical.impact: This change was necessary to avoid reported schedule delays and additional costs.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Inadequate conduit size specification for BIM modeling
electrical.prevention_action: Establish clear conduit size requirements during initial design and coordination phases.

electrical.specific_condition: Lighting inverter equipment for phase 3 was stated to be OFCI in RFP RFI #82 response and IFP R.1 drawing P3-E01-26, but was later confirmed to be CFCI.
electrical.impact: The change from OFCI to CFCI requires additional work and costs associated with the procurement and installation of the lighting inverter.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Change in equipment classification from OFCI to CFCI
electrical.prevention_action: Ensure clear communication and documentation of equipment classifications in project meetings and drawings.

electrical.specific_condition: Furniture layout changes require additional poke-thrus due to tables moving away from the wall and power pole feeds needing to be adjusted to base feeds to avoid obstruction in front of windows.
electrical.impact: The need for additional poke-thrus and changes to power feeds increases project costs and complicates electrical routing.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Furniture layout modification requiring additional electrical provisions
electrical.prevention_action: Ensure furniture plans are finalized and coordinated with electrical layouts before construction begins.

electrical.specific_condition: Power/data locations for multiple rooms (Office 2069, Office 2094, Training Room 2081, Conference 2003 & 3003, Conference 3075, Training Room 3028) need to be confirmed and relocated due to layout changes and AV rack installation requirements.
electrical.impact: Additional work and costs incurred for relocating power/data connections and installing backing for AV racks, which affects the overall project timeline and budget.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Changes in room layouts and AV rack locations not accounted for in original plans.
electrical.prevention_action: Conduct thorough coordination meetings and reviews of room layouts and AV requirements during the design phase to ensure all changes are documented and communicated.

electrical.specific_condition: Fire strobes are shown at a minimum height of 72 inches AFF, but there is a need to confirm if the TV can be mounted at a higher elevation to avoid conflicts.
electrical.impact: Potential conflicts or obstructions between the fire strobe and the monitor after field installation.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Height clearance conflict between fire strobe and monitor installation
electrical.prevention_action: Conduct thorough MEP coordination meetings to confirm device heights and clearances before finalizing installation plans.

electrical.specific_condition: Fire Strobe shift behind monitors on GL-2/A.1
electrical.impact: Requires an additional strobe on the North elevation for adequate coverage
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Change in fire alarm system layout
electrical.prevention_action: Conduct thorough coordination meetings to finalize fire alarm layout before construction

electrical.specific_condition: Heavy space constraints in the B2 Main Electrical Room due to the size of the ERRCS head-end units.

electrical.specific_condition: Additional external isolation pads are needed for all 9 dry-type transformers due to comments from Salter on the transformer submittal.

electrical.specific_condition: Modifications to the underground infrastructure based on the 10/4/23 MAWD Redesign meeting, including removal and relocation of TVs and addition of receptacles.

electrical.specific_condition: Need for confirmation on the acceptability of (3x) dual raceway light poles for hosting security cameras and lights as per the attached markup.
electrical.impact: Potential delays in installation and coordination of security cameras and site speakers due to uncertainty in light pole configurations.
electrical.root_cause_subcategory: Coordination of light pole configurations with security camera and speaker placements not finalized.

electrical.specific_condition: Proposed power feed locations for signage may not be adequate as per the design requirements.
